name: Wix.com Ltd.
summary: Wix.com Ltd. operates a cloud-based web development platform for registered users and creators in the United States, Europe, Israel, and internationally. The company offers Wix Editor, a drag-and-drop visual development and website editing environment platform and Wix Studio, a unified website development platform that enables the creation of advanced websites.
